## Problem and result

What problem does this solve, and what changes for a reader or contributor?

## Related work (optional)

Link the issue or OpenSpec change when relevant. A small correction does not
require a new issue or change.

## Evidence and checks

Describe relevant sources, checks performed and limitations. For a text/link
correction, document/link consistency and diff checks may be enough. Product,
Home Assistant and device checks are only applicable when explicitly in scope;
there is no product build or runtime test suite yet.

## Scope and decision impact (if applicable)

Identify affected roadmap stages, decisions and documents. Distinguish measured
results from proposals. Omit this section for corrections with no scope impact.
